evidence: validation observations (mapped into verification evidence — provenance preserved)

rule: A new artifact must be classified before creation. Derived artifacts cannot become authoritative by convention or caller choice. Evidence cannot directly mutate normative or authoritative state.

new_derived_artifacts: ValidationRun (the outcome of one synthetic execution; provenance-bound to /verification)
ValidationObservation (a single raw observation; provenance-bound to /verification)
ArchitectureRiskRecommendation (the closed-loop synthesis output: WORK-070, feeds the /architecture ACR authority)
v1_1_continuous_product_validation_sub_e.invariant: Validation evidence maps INTO the EXISTING /verification evidence authority as a derived artifact (provenance preserved). No parallel evidence store. No customer-product validation failure may be silently discarded, converted into a false healthy state, or directly converted into an ungoverned code change.
v1_1_continuous_product_validation_sub_e.activation: These artifacts become governing only when ACR-001 + ACR-002 are approved by the architect and the corresponding Work Orders (WORK-064..070) are implemented and merged. Until then, they are design-time proposed state in spec/architecture/v1.1/.
